# SmartBiz Coach — AI Business Operating System & Market Square for Nigerian MSMEs

> SmartBiz Coach (https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/) is Nigeria's premier AI Business Operating System, National MSME Market Square, and Alternative Credit Underwriting Suite built specifically for small business owners across Nigeria.

## Core Pillars & Solutions

### 1. Central MSME Market Square & Personal Online Storefronts
- **Market Square URL**: https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/market
- **Personal Storefronts**: `https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/u/{brand_slug}`
- **Capabilities**: Connects buyers and sellers across all 36 Nigerian states and Abuja. Zero listing fees, verified CAC and SMEDAN trust badges, 1-click WhatsApp order routing, and secure Paystack Escrow payments.
- **Nationwide Delivery Quoting**: Automatic delivery fee calculation customized by merchants for all 36 states and FCT.
- **Live Order Tracking**: Public tracking portal at `https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/track` allowing buyers to confirm receipt using a 4-digit code.
- **Verified Buyer Reviews**: 100% verified-purchase feedback system with seller public replies.

### 2. Daily Retail POS & Camera Barcode Scanner
- **Capabilities**: 5-second counter checkout supporting Cash, POS Card, Bank Transfer, and Customer Debt.
- **Smartphone Camera Barcode/QR Scanner**: Reads UPC/EAN barcodes using phone cameras with audio feedback, eliminating the need for expensive hardware.
- **Anti-Theft Apprentice Lock**: Supervisor 4-digit PIN locks cashier attendants from backdating records, modifying prices, or viewing total owner profits.
- **100% Open Market Offline PWA Mode**: Functions without internet connectivity in high-density Nigerian open markets (Alaba, Balogun, Computer Village) and syncs when reconnected.

### 3. Gbege Book (Receivables & WhatsApp Debt Recovery)
- **Capabilities**: Dual ledger tracking "Who Dey Owe Me" and "Who I Owe".
- **WhatsApp Automated Reminders**: 3-tier polite-to-formal escalation messages with embedded encrypted Paystack debit/transfer payment links.
- **1-Tap Invoicing & Receipts**: Instant itemized PDF receipts and automated debt reconciliation upon payment.

### 4. Snap-to-Studio 2.0 (Commercial AI Photography)
- **Capabilities**: Transforms raw smartphone photos taken on bedsheets, shop counters, or floors into 16 luxury commercial 4K sets (Marble, Fluted Wood, African Raffia, Sunlight & Shadows, Cafe Tables) with realistic contact shadows and glossy reflections.
- **1-Click WhatsApp Promo Copy**: Auto-generates Nigerian Pidgin and English promotional broadcast and status captions.

### 5. Institutional Credit Underwriting & Data Science
- **Algorithmic FICO 300-850 Score**: Scikit-Learn machine learning engine evaluating real-world ledger volume, cashflow consistency, and debt recovery velocity without collateral.
- **Stockout Demand Forecaster**: Ridge regression predicting exact stockout dates before weekend trading rushes.
- **Till Fraud Isolation Forest**: Unsupervised anomaly detection uncovering petty cash leakage and cashier till discrepancies.

### 6. Legal Tax Shield & Accredited CAC Desk
- **Section 23 CITA Exemption Memo**: Official legal memorandum citing Companies Income Tax Act Section 23/40 (0% corporate tax for MSMEs with gross turnover under ₦25,000,000).
- **Accredited CAC Desk**: Done-for-you CAC Business Name, Limited Liability Company, and SCUML registrations.
